recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded correction for current core build inputs that still carried the obsolete single-bundle sentence; the related PA issues should remain background for this seed rather than separate opportunistic decisions because their scoped artifacts were already handled in source history and are not the remaining core mismatch.
issue_request: FHIR-13542 was Published/Persuasive and asked that $everything allow a server to page results when appropriate instead of requiring the entire result set in a single Bundle unless the client requested otherwise; the resolution called for documenting $everything paging, performance implications, and optional descending last-updated sorting.
initial_application: The 2018 application appears in git as 3e2924dc7e9eef23cf97085a8cb3491ad5ec8781 (svn build@13071), which added _count plus paging/performance/sorting discussion to Patient, Encounter, and Group $everything spreadsheet sources. Later refactors moved the content into standalone OperationDefinition XML. That application preserved the older opening bullet requiring one bundle unless the client requested paging, which became contradictory beside the new server-required paging text.
additional_context: Later Applied PA decisions FHIR-44604, FHIR-43373, and FHIR-44816 removed the same single-bundle sentence from Patient, Encounter, and EpisodeOfCare and reframed the key difference as freeing clients from choosing included resources. Current core no longer contains Patient/Encounter/EpisodeOfCare $everything definitions, but it still contains active Group and MedicinalProductDefinition $everything OperationDefinitions referenced by resource operation lists. A Zulip HAPI thread shows implementer confusion caused by the old sentence and no conflicting rationale for keeping it was found.
reconciliation: Updated source/group/operationdefinition-Group-everything.xml and source/medicinalproductdefinition/operationdefinition-MedicinalProductDefinition-everything.xml so their footer/comment text no longer says the server returns all results in a single bundle unless the client requests otherwise. The existing _count parameters, server-required paging allowance, performance warning, and sorting guidance were retained.
source_changes: source/group/operationdefinition-Group-everything.xml: removed the stale single-bundle bullet from both the rendered footer extension and OperationDefinition.comment while preserving paging guidance.

source/medicinalproductdefinition/operationdefinition-MedicinalProductDefinition-everything.xml: removed the stale single-bundle bullet from both the rendered footer extension and OperationDefinition.comment while preserving paging guidance.
